points.evidence: The selected cleanup requires wow_message_stack layout and typed cleanup calls. Original W32Exception only chooses exception disposition/RET_FORCETASKEXIT; registration bridge releases borrow/scheduler state, not message-owned allocation keys.
points.minimal_option: Keep one include; remove standalone project explanation.

points.evidence: wow_hook_callback.c saves fThunkDDEmsg before wow_task_callback_enter. A PeekMessage(PM_NOREMOVE) conversion sets FALSE; another native hook thread can snapshot FALSE before acquiring WOW execution. A restores TRUE; later B restores its stale FALSE globally. W32Win16WndProcEx DDE converters then read FALSE and skip FreeDDElParam. TLS keeps snapshots thread-local. This is a source-permitted ordering, not a reproduced race.
points.minimal_option: Keep TLS declaration; remove standalone comment. Restoring global needs additional cross-thread selector ownership, not a plain original substitution.

points.evidence: Original entry allocates/converts before CallBack16; constructor false goes to DefWindowProc without unthunk, and exceptions bypass normal unthunk. W32Exception cannot access this stack-local message. Cleanup reads uMsg/lpfnM32/keys on early failures; original uninitialized record supplies invalid keys. stackalloc16 changes vpCBStack/init before later copy/callback failures; callback cleanup begins after construction and cannot restore pre-construction state.
points.minimal_option: Keep zero initialization and one scope around existing message flow. No second resource map.

points.evidence: EM_SCROLLCARET invokes native EditWndProc and returns before normal completed assignment. Existing exact-branch control preserves nested callback stack on completed return; deleting marker restores old cursor incorrectly. Exception control still restores cursor.
points.minimal_option: Keep one completed marker; do not change native-only behavior.

points.evidence: After original unthunk succeeds the message stack lifecycle must distinguish normal completion from failed construction/callback; otherwise helper restores its entry cursor/init on every ordinary return. Existing completed/failed stack controls distinguish these cases.
points.minimal_option: Keep one completion marker after original unthunk.

points.evidence: Original normal unthunk is bypassed on conversion failure or SEH escape. Exact-body transaction controls exercise partial allocation, copy faults, nested construction, and stack rollback; W32Exception has no local allocation keys. Unconditional replay of output unthunkers would copy partial output. Existing capture-key cleanup avoids that.
points.minimal_option: Retain one cleanup finalizer; removed redundant !completed local because helper already checks it. Preserve AbnormalTermination for cleanup exceptions.

points.evidence: CBT sets uMsg=0 and calls WM32Create directly rather than setting lpfnM32 through aw32Msg. Cleanup distinguishes nested CREATE resources using lpfnM32. Removing assignment falls into generic release and misses class/nested keys. All automatic owners are zero-initialized, so dwTmp[3] initializer is redundant.
points.minimal_option: Removed redundant zero and comment; keep one direct-CBT selector assignment.
